entities.name: Spaceship Parts
entities.summary: 50 spaceship parts. You first need to finish the Franklin stranger mission Omega; once all parts are found and returned, the Space Docker becomes available in Omega's garage.

entities.name: Letter Scraps
entities.summary: 50 letter scraps (pieces of a torn letter) are scattered around San Andreas. They tie into the Franklin stranger mission A Starlet in Vinewood. Collecting all 50 is one of the required miscellaneous activities for 100%.

entities.name: Nuclear Waste
entities.summary: 30 yellow biohazard barrels dumped underwater. After buying the Sonar Collections Dock you use a Trackify app as a radar; GamePressure lists about $23,000 per barrel and a $250,000 bonus when all are collected.

entities.name: Submarine Pieces
entities.summary: Underwater submarine parts that become available after buying the Sonar Collections Dock ($250,000). GTA5Wiki lists 30 pieces and a Kraken submersible as the reward, tied to an Abigail Mathers strand, which conflicts with GamePressure (Michael, purchase-driven); the character and the reward are therefore unconfirmed.

entities.name: Peyote Plants
entities.summary: 27 peyote plants, exclusive to the PS4, Xbox One and PC versions and later. Eating one triggers a hallucination in which you play as a random Land, Sea or Air animal; the plants respawn after collection.

entities.name: Stunt Jumps
entities.summary: 50 stunt jumps; 25 of them are required for 100% completion.

entities.name: Under the Bridge
entities.summary: 50 bridges to pass under (by plane); 25 of them are required for 100% completion.

entities.name: Knife Flights
entities.summary: 15 knife flights (flying a plane through narrow gaps); 8 of them are required for 100% completion.

entities.name: Monkey Mosaics
entities.summary: 50 Monkey Mosaics to photograph, available in the versions on newer consoles and PC. Photographing them all rewards a monkey disguise and a monkey-livery car in your garage.

entities.name: Epsilon Tracts
entities.summary: Epsilon Tracts are collected after Michael completes the eight Epsilon Program missions. Marnie sends a message with a link to a long text, the Epsilon Tract of the 9th Paradigm, as the reward. The total is 10 according to GTA5Wiki.

entities.name: Hidden Packages
entities.summary: Hidden packages exist in GTA V Story Mode: GTA5Wiki lists 12, and GamePressure shows roughly a dozen cash values on its map. Almost all are underwater (ship or plane wrecks) and contain cash and, per GTA5Wiki, sometimes weapons.

entities.name: Trevor's Trailer
entities.summary: Trevor Philips' trailer in Sandy Shores, Blaine County.

entities.name: Michael's House
entities.summary: Michael De Santa's residence in Rockford Hills, Los Santos. Michael's safehouse.

entities.name: Franklin's House in Strawberry
entities.summary: Franklin Clinton's first residence, in Strawberry, South Los Santos.

entities.name: Franklin's House in Vinewood Hills
entities.summary: Franklin's later residence in the Vinewood Hills overlooking Los Santos.
